top_function: Fibronectins bind cell surfaces and various compounds including collagen, fibrin, heparin, DNA, and actin (PubMed:3024962, PubMed:3593230, PubMed:3900070, PubMed:7989369). Fibronectins are involved in

go_terms_mf.go_name: oxidoreductase activity, acting on NADH or NADPH
vascular endothelial growth factor receptor binding

go_terms_bp.go_name: P:biological process involved in interaction with symbiont
positive regulation of transcription by RNA pol II
epidermal growth factor receptor signaling pathway
positive regulation of insulin receptor signaling pathway
